label: late original-phase input i / after 2, in s- or b-initial sequences containing x/t
explanation: Sparse conjunctive feature. Fires only in the original phase or on <DEL> (never during copying), at steps 4-7, and almost entirely in sequences whose first token is s (65% of mass) or b (20%). Within those it is strongest when the input is i (48% of mass, 13x lift) or the previous token is 2, and when x/t/2/o came earlier (top example: s h 3 x t 2 i). It does not fire at t<3 or anywhere in the copy phase. Being in a late original step of an s/b-initial sequence covers 85% of mass but with about 1% precision, so the feature depends on some finer hidden-state combination that this predicate misses. The recorded predicate gets dev F1 0.31 and mass recall 0.41.
